svg.title: Two lifting paths into one backend, compared under the official Luau VM
svg.desc: A source program at the left feeds two horizontal paths. Path 1 (AST): luau-ast, a JSON syntax tree, lift_source.luau (the source frontend), and a lifter_ir_v1 handoff whose evidence is source_span. Path 2 (disassembly): luau-compile --text --dump-constants -O0 -g0, a text listing of one function, compiler_disassembly_adapter.mjs (the caller declares function_index and parameter_count), a handoff document, lift_compiler_disassembly.luau (the bridge), and a lifter_ir_v1 handoff whose evidence is decoded_record. Both handoffs enter, each separately, one dashed cluster, the backend, the same binary for both paths: core admission (validate core), checked resolution (resolve-admitted-readable-ir), emission admission (validate readable-luau) and normalization (normalize-ir), then one command, emit-readable-luau-strategy, that re-runs emission admission (readable-luau) on its input, then runs structure (the planner, structure.zig) and emission (standard-luau) with two outputs: automatic, and dispatcher (control: same IR, forced state-machine form). A refusal or error in any of these stages exits with status 1 and no output, and ends that path. Below, three emitted Luau artefacts, path 1 automatic, path 2 automatic and dispatcher control (from the path 2 handoff only), each pass luau-compile --null, luau-ast and luau-compile --binary -O0 -g0 and go to the native observer (official Luau VM), which loads only bytecode, has no host bindings and runs one fresh process per artifact and input. The source program is also compiled by luau-compile --binary -O0 -g0 into the original bytecode, which enters the observer on a dashed edge labelled compared against; an input grid of (selector, budget) pairs also feeds the observer. The observer's double-bordered result is agreement per input over the input grid: equally many values, each pair IEEE-equal. A note reads: same source, same compiler build; the disassembly side parses one function's text listing.
